title: Cloncurry Courthouse

terrainReference.basis: Native ground immediately west of the principal Scheaffe Street courtroom stair.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Cloncurry Courthouse building outline
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 924071838 identifies the named standing 18-node courthouse roof envelope. The west porch faces Scheaffe Street and the grounds are registered at Daintree Street.

note: The public-domain Queensland State Archives 1907 section and front elevation establish deep low stumps, hipped and gabled corrugated roofs, a frontal porch and shelter to the three courtroom sides. The official heritage listing records connected later ranges.
